verdict: Live Nation set a record quarter with $10.1B of revenue, up 19%, as 61 million fans attended shows and consolidated net income reached $567M.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, available to common stockholders, vs $0.73 a year ago

segments.name: Concerts
segments.note: Promoting and producing live shows and running venues — 61 million fans attended in the quarter, up 19%, with international attendance up 29%.

segments.name: Ticketing
segments.note: Ticketmaster ticket sales: 98 million fee-bearing tickets in the quarter, up 10%, with gross transaction value of $11.2B, up 13%.

segments.name: Sponsorship, advertising & other
segments.note: Sponsorship and advertising revenue of $506M, up 14%, less $17M of other and intersegment eliminations — combined so the lines foot to total revenue, following the same treatment as the release's 'Other and Eliminations' line.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling tickets and shows and running the company.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of venues, systems and intangibles over their working lives.

opex.name: Loss on disposal of operating assets
opex.note: A small loss selling operating assets (a year ago this was a $15M gain).

takeaways.title: Fans showed up in record numbers
takeaways.text: Attendance grew 19% to 61 million, international markets supplied 60% of the growth, and 170 million tickets for 2026 shows had been sold through October — already ahead of all of 2025.

takeaways.title: All three businesses grew AOI
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income (non-GAAP) rose 14% to $1,179M: Concerts $603M (+17%), Ticketing $316M (+10%) and Sponsorship & Advertising $350M (+12%). GAAP operating income was $892M, up 13%.

takeaways.title: Shareholders' share of profit
takeaways.text: Consolidated net income was $567M; after $119M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $448M belonged to Live Nation common stockholders. After $43M of accretion on redeemable interests, diluted EPS available was $1.69.

oneTimers: A $7M loss on disposal of operating assets this quarter compares with a $15M gain a year ago.

Nine-month corporate expenses include a $450M charge for governmental investigations and litigation recorded earlier in 2026 — it is not in this quarter's $114M corporate line, but it is why nine-month GAAP operating income is down 25% despite the record third quarter.
otherDetail: Net other expense of $67M: interest expense $102M and $4M of equity losses and $1M of other expense, partly offset by $40M of interest income (rounded from the statement's $102M / $40M / $4M / $1M lines).
footerNote: Net income in the flow is consolidated net income of $567M, before $119M attributable to noncontrolling interests; net income attributable to Live Nation common stockholders was $448M. Direct operating expenses are shown as $7,748M (the statement prints $7,747M) so rounded millions foot exactly to the $892M operating income the company reports. The third segment combines Sponsorship & Advertising ($506M) with Other and Eliminations (-$17M) so segments foot to total revenue with no negative line.
